content.subject: Proposed changes to the agreement
content.body: Hello, thank you for providing the agreement. I look forward to working together and have two quick notes: - Regarding the scope of work, the relevant clause allows for additional services without extra compensation, and I propose that any out-of-scope requests be subject to a separate written change order and mutually agreed compensation. - Regarding the intellectual property terms, rights are granted without being conditioned upon full payment, and I propose that ownership transfer only upon receipt of full payment for the deliverables. Thank you for your flexibility and best regards.
